scope: predict 30-day repeat purchase among customers with history available at a monthly cutoff

eligibility.dataset: a separately approved source or prospective vintage not inspected before design freeze
exclude: cutoffs lacking a fully observed 30-day outcome window

cutoffs.training_rule: only labels whose horizon ends on or before evaluation cutoff
cutoffs.final_confirmation_rule: chronologically last 6 eligible cutoffs, untouched until code and dataset audit are locked
cutoffs.development_rule: all earlier eligible cutoffs; no final-confirmation metrics may inform changes

model.estimator: logistic regression with existing fixed preprocessing

recalibration.fallback: intercept-only prevalence correction if fewer than 200 positives in calibration pool; identity if fitting fails
recalibration.pool: predictions from the most recent 6 completed development cutoffs, generated by models that did not train on those episodes
recalibration.refresh: once per cutoff using completed outcomes only
recalibration.comparison: report uncalibrated and recalibrated metrics; ranking is evaluated on the unchanged score

evaluation.uncertainty: two-sided 95% customer-cluster bootstrap interval with 2000 fixed-seed resamples
evaluation.missing_metric_rule: fail the protocol; do not silently omit a cutoff

decision_thresholds.confirm_ranking: primary PR-AUC gain >= 0.10, cluster-bootstrap CI lower bound > 0, and positive gain in at least 5 of 6 final cutoffs
decision_thresholds.confirm_calibration: recalibrated aggregate Brier skill > 0, ECE <= 0.05, calibration slope in [0.8, 1.2], intercept in [-0.1, 0.1], and no final cutoff Brier skill < 0
decision_thresholds.segment_guardrail: PR-AUC gain > 0 for both one-invoice vs multi-invoice and tenure <90 vs >=90 day groups where each has >=100 positives; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
decision_thresholds.policy_threshold: top 10% by score per cutoff, deterministic tie break by SHA-256(customer_id + cutoff + protocol); evaluation only, not authorization to contact or deploy
decision_thresholds.overall: CONFIRM only if ranking, calibration, falsification, and segment guardrails pass; otherwise FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE exactly as specified

falsification.pass_rule: all leakage validators reject injected future features; permutation and ID-hash primary gains each <= 0.02 with CI including 0; timestamp-shifted construction must fail eligibility validation
falsification.multiplicity: falsifications are gate checks, not evidence for model selection

monitoring.reference: pooled development cutoffs from the approved confirmation dataset
monitoring.response: quarantine the cutoff, investigate data lineage, and do not adapt using final-confirmation outcomes

stop_rules: stop before data access if license, consent, provenance, stable IDs, timestamps, or entity-disjointness cannot be documented
stop if minimum cutoffs, episodes, or positives are not met
stop and invalidate confirmation if final outcomes or metrics are inspected before lock
stop and version a new prospective protocol for any feature, endpoint, cutoff, model, calibration, threshold, or exclusion change
stop without deployment if any falsification gate fails or overall decision is FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE
